items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: We had a translator. Translate a letter. Her name was Data. D-A-T-A. I remember that as plain as I can see it now.

ctx.x: That's how it's working. Brunis. B-R-U-N-I-S. Whatever we'd write to the relatives in Germany, we always had to address it B-R-U-N-I-A-S. Because I remember... Well, they were German. Yeah. But they were under a French flag. Under the French flag. And also... How the E got in there? Well, I'm not. But the original family name was I-A-S. Because we had an aunt. I remember. We had a translator. Translate a letter. Her name was Data. D-A-T-A. I remember that as plain as I can see it now. And Grandma had some German…
Yes, I've heard of it. That was before my time.
